checkerProvenance.geometricModel: Every selected electrical F.Cu pad is transformed from the pinned footprint source at the current target pose. Rectangles and rounded rectangles/ovals/circles are modeled as an axis-aligned core rectangle Minkowski-summed with a disk. Segment-to-core distance minus pad radius and trace half-width gives finite-width clearance; all non-net copper, including intentional NC pads, remains an obstacle.
checkerProvenance.sourceRoutedGeometry: 38 source-proposal segment capsules, four nets,14 exact pad-centre anchors and zero vias; no package-internal line is counted as copper.
checkerProvenance.precision: Channel topology/length/gap engine uses integer-nanometre primitives and exact axis/diagonal length forms. Independent analytical Euclidean checks use a1e-8mm floating comparison tolerance only.

coordinateConvention: mm, component-side view, northwest origin, +X east,+Y south. Each path has explicit constant width; consecutive points are segment endpoints.
